products.title: The Loma | Sierra Madre

Meet the Loma Sierra Madre Edition — We teamed up with Sunday Golf to create a limited-edition Loma Bag with some serious Bad Madre DNA. It's lightweight (<2 lbs), compact, and built for quick rounds, casual loops, and anyone who doesn’t feel like lugging 14 clubs (who does, tbh?). Limited run. BIG energy.
